blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Quezon Rep. Mark Enverga, chairperson of the House committee on agriculture and food, has expressed concern over falling farmgate prices of live hogs despite persistently high retail pork prices, saying both local producers and consumers are bearing the brunt of the disparity. “The continued decline in farmgate prices of hogs while retail pork prices remain high is alarming,” Enverga said in a statement on Monday, Oct. 12. Citing data gathered by his office, Enverga said farmgate prices of live hogs dropped from P215 per kilogram in June 2025 to P150 in August 2026, with prices falling to as […]...
